name: separator
behavior: APG separator pattern (decorative by default: hidden from assistive tech; semantic when it divides content regions: role=separator with aria-orientation; never focusable)

parts.note: prominence axis rebinds the color: subtle → border-subtle, default → border, strong → border-strong (the 3-tier separator scale, semantic.md §1)

anatomyNotes: Decorative vs semantic is a usage flag, not a variant: shadcn defaults decorative (aria-hidden), Salt Divider always renders role=separator — components must expose the choice. Prominence here uses the ordered subtle/default/strong scale (naming.md), mapping to Salt's tertiary/secondary/primary divider variants.
